Exchange: Replacing an item with a different size, colour or product of equal or greater value.
Store Credit: A balance issued to a customer account, redeemable online and in stores, valid for 5 years.
RMA: Return Merchandise Authorization number, e.g. RMA-2026-004815, required for mailed returns.
Final Sale: Items marked 'Final Sale' at the time of purchase, which cannot be returned.
Original Condition: Unused, unwashed, with all tags, packaging and accessories included.
Defective items | Covered by warranty - see Section 14

Most items purchased from Northwind may be returned within 30 calendar days of the delivery date (or purchase date for in-store sales) for a full refund of the item price, provided the item is in original condition.
Standard merchandise | 30 days
Northwind Rewards Gold members | 60 days
Holiday purchases (Nov 1 - Dec 24) | Until January 31 of the following year
Footwear (worn indoors only) | 45 days
Camping tents and sleeping bags (unused) | 60 days

Returns without proof of purchase are accepted in-store only, for store credit at the lowest price the item was sold in the last 90 days. A government-issued photo ID is required and scanned. A limit of three receipt-less returns per customer per 12-month period applies.
Exchanges for a different size or colour are free of charge, including shipping both ways, when requested within the return window and when the replacement item is in stock.
The request is made within the applicable return window.
The item is in original condition: unused, unwashed, undamaged, with original tags attached.
The item is returned with all accessories, manuals, free gifts and original packaging where practical.
The order number or proof of purchase can be verified in our systems.
The item is not on the non-refundable list in Section 5.
Like new, tags attached | 100%
Opened packaging, item unused | 100%
Missing original box (non-fragile) | 90%
Missing accessories or free gift | Refund minus gift value
Light wear or signs of use | 50% - 75%
Damaged by customer / heavy use | 0% - 25% (agent discretion, manager approval)
Washed, altered or stained | Not eligible
Up to $100: Tier 1 agent may approve.
$100.01 - $500: Tier 2 agent or team lead approval required.
Over $500: Customer Experience Manager approval required.
Over $2,000: Finance Director approval and fraud review required.
Items marked Final Sale or Clearance - All Sales Final at checkout.
Gift cards and e-gift cards (see Section 13).
Downloadable software, digital guides and trail-map files once downloaded.
Personalised or custom-engraved items, including monogrammed jackets and embroidered packs.
Opened hygiene items: water bottles' mouthpieces, thermal underwear, socks, and swimwear without liner tags.
Fuel canisters, bear spray, and other hazardous materials once opened or shipped.
Perishable goods such as freeze-dried meals past 14 days from delivery.
Installation, repair, and gear-fitting services already performed.
Items returned more than 90 days after delivery.

Even for non-refundable items, a full refund or replacement will be provided if the item arrives damaged, is materially different from its description, or was shipped in error. Report these issues within 7 days of delivery with photos.

Customers who choose store credit instead of a refund to their card receive a 5% bonus on the credit value (up to a maximum bonus of $25.00 per return). Bonus credit cannot be applied retroactively once a refund has been issued to the card.
Standard merchandise, change of mind | $5.99 deducted from refund
Exchange (size/colour) | Free both ways | Replacement shipped free
Defective or damaged | Free | Full refund including original shipping
Wrong item sent | Free | Full refund including original shipping
Gold member, any reason | Free | Full refund of item price
Return freight for change-of-mind returns is a flat $49.00, deducted from the refund. Freight pickups must be scheduled with our logistics team at least 3 business days in advance.
Report issues within 7 calendar days of delivery via the online returns portal or customer care. Please include clear photos of the damage, defect or incorrect item.
Partial refund (keep item) | Offered for minor cosmetic flaws where item remains fully functional | 20% refund; item retained

For damaged items valued under $40.00, we may issue a refund without requiring the item to be returned ("Keep It" policy), at the agent's discretion. This is limited to two instances per customer per year.
Order placed (within 30 mins) | Yes - self-service | Full refund, immediate auth release
Processing / allocated | Call support - attempted, not guaranteed | Full refund if stopped; else return process
Shipped | No | Must receive and start return
Backordered items | Yes - anytime before allocation | Full refund immediately
Custom or engraved items | Within 2 hours of order only | 100% refund; no cancellation after production starts
Trailhead Box | Monthly, 1st of month | Anytime before 25th | No refund for current month; next box cancelled. May pause up to 3 months.
Rewards Plus | Annual | Anytime | Pro-rated refund within first 60 days; no refund after 60 days.
If you forget to cancel and are charged, contact us within 7 days for a full refund of the first charge.
Gear Care Plan | Monthly | Anytime | No refund for current month; plan ends at end of billing cycle.

Digital goods such as trail guides (PDF), camping-skills video series, and GPS waypoint files are non-refundable once downloaded. If you have not downloaded the file, contact us within 14 days of purchase for a full refund.
Gift card purchases cannot be cancelled once the code is delivered by email. Northwind gift cards do not expire and carry no maintenance fees.
Sleeping bags | Lifetime (manufacturing defects) | Repair or replace
Backpacks | 5 years | Repair or replace
Footwear | 1 year | Replace or refund (prorated by age)
Apparel | 1 year | Replace or repair
Water filters | 1 year | Replace cartridge or unit
Tents and shelters | 2 years | Repair, replacement parts, or replacement
Electronics (headlamps, GPS) | 1 year | Repair or replace (manufacturer warranty applies)
Stoves and cookware | 2 years | Repair or replacement parts
Items shipped directly by third-party sellers follow the seller's policy, but Northwind's A-to-Z Guarantee ensures a refund if the seller fails to respond within 5 business days.
United States | 30 days | See Section 9 | Included
Canada | 30 days | Customer pays unless defective | Duties refunded, customer files GST/HST
UK | 30 days (14-day statutory minimum) | Customer pays unless defective | VAT refunded, duty via customs claim
EU | 30 days (14-day statutory minimum) | Customer pays unless defective | VAT refunded
Rest of world | 14 days | Customer pays | Not refundable
Refunds are issued in the currency of the original charge. Exchange rate differences between purchase and refund dates are not compensated.

If a chargeback dispute is lost, transaction funds are debited; a $15 administration fee may apply for fraudulent claims.
